_comment: Expectations after schema_migrations_input_sync_modes.json. From manual session: 5 migrations — AddColumnInHistoryMode(article), DropColumnInHistoryMode(desc), CopyTableToHistoryMode(transaction->new_transaction_history), MigrateSoftDeleteToHistory(transaction), MigrateHistoryToSoftDelete(new_transaction_history). End state: tester_transaction = 6 rows in history mode (with _fivetran_start/_end/_active); tester_transaction_history = 13 rows (article populated for active versions, desc nulled for active versions); tester_new_transaction_history = 6 rows in soft-delete mode (with _fivetran_deleted, no _fivetran_start).

assertions.name: tester_transaction has 6 rows after MigrateSoftDeleteToHistory
assertions.sql: SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM tester_transaction) t WHERE t.c <> 6

assertions.name: tester_transaction was migrated to history mode (has _fivetran_active column)
assertions.sql: SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM dbc.columnsv WHERE databasename = DATABASE AND tablename = 'tester_transaction' AND columnname = '_fivetran_active') t WHERE t.c <> 1

assertions.name: tester_transaction has no _fivetran_deleted column anymore (history mode)
assertions.sql: SELECT 1 FROM dbc.columnsv WHERE databasename = DATABASE AND tablename = 'tester_transaction' AND columnname = '_fivetran_deleted'

assertions.name: tester_transaction_history has 13 rows (6 base + AddColumn versioning + DropColumn versioning)
assertions.sql: SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM tester_transaction_history) t WHERE t.c <> 13

assertions.name: tester_transaction_history has the article column (AddColumnInHistoryMode)
assertions.sql: SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM dbc.columnsv WHERE databasename = DATABASE AND tablename = 'tester_transaction_history' AND columnname = 'article') t WHERE t.c <> 1

assertions.name: active tester_transaction_history rows have article = 'Ordered article'
assertions.sql: SELECT 1 FROM tester_transaction_history WHERE _fivetran_active = 1 AND (article IS NULL OR article <> 'Ordered article')

assertions.name: active tester_transaction_history rows have desc = NULL (DropColumnInHistoryMode soft-drop)
assertions.sql: SELECT 1 FROM tester_transaction_history WHERE _fivetran_active = 1 AND "desc" IS NOT NULL

assertions.name: tester_new_transaction_history has 6 rows after MigrateHistoryToSoftDelete
assertions.sql: SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM tester_new_transaction_history) t WHERE t.c <> 6

assertions.name: tester_new_transaction_history has _fivetran_deleted column (soft-delete mode)
assertions.sql: SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM dbc.columnsv WHERE databasename = DATABASE AND tablename = 'tester_new_transaction_history' AND columnname = '_fivetran_deleted') t WHERE t.c <> 1

assertions.name: tester_new_transaction_history has no _fivetran_start column anymore (soft-delete mode)
assertions.sql: SELECT 1 FROM dbc.columnsv WHERE databasename = DATABASE AND tablename = 'tester_new_transaction_history' AND columnname = '_fivetran_start'

assertions.name: all tester_new_transaction_history rows are not deleted (_fivetran_deleted=0)
